title: plugin-gantt: link-type switcher silently reverts on id-only dependency stores (线条闪一下又还原)
body:
On data sources that persist dependencies as bare predecessor ids (no type slot — e.g. a lookup array of predecessor records), picking ss/ff/sf in the dependency-link context menu optimistically recolors the arrow, the persist drops the type, and the silent refetch snaps it back to FS: the arrow flashes and reverts (线条闪一下,又显示成「完成→开始」). The type switcher is a misleading UI for such stores — no choice other than FS can ever stick.

Reproduced live on a 4-level 排班计划 tree whose gantt uses an api provider with `predecessors` as an id comma-list.

## Fix direction (PR follows)

New `gantt.dependencyTypes` view config (default `true`). Declaring `false`:
- hides the fs/ss/ff/sf section of the link context menu (remove-dependency stays);
- pins drag-created links to FS regardless of which endpoints were connected.
